headline: Turnaround is real, priced for it too
chart_note: 52-week range: $77.99 - $110.51. Currently $104.47, near the top of its 52-week range.
why_today: Fiscal Q3 global comparable sales jumped 7.9%, with North America up 8.1% and traffic up 4.5% - CEO Brian Niccol's turnaround is showing up in the numbers, and management raised full-year EPS guidance to $2.55-$2.65.
pro_1: Comp sales acceleration and traffic growth beat estimates across every region
pro_2: Analyst consensus is Buy from 37 analysts covering the stock
con_1: At 60x trailing earnings, a lot of the turnaround is already priced in - average price target of $106 implies only about 2% upside from here
con_2: Reported revenue actually slipped 1% YoY due to the China retail stake divestiture, muddying the headline growth picture
